evidence.quote: Fees would be separately subject to court approval, with any unawarded amount added to the class fund.
Brightline can discuss an automatic $27 million class fund plus $2 million in court-reviewed fees, with any unawarded fees going to the class.
We accept Brightline’s latest term sheet: a $29 million class fund distributed automatically, plus $2 million in separately paid fees subject to court approval

summary: Plaintiff counsel first raised fees, and the parties discussed fee amounts before agreeing on the class fund. The proposed terms expressly directed any unawarded fees to the class. The transcript does not show counsel sacrificing class relief for its own fees, defense exploiting fee interests, or a misleading court declaration.
